intent.raw_query: Vietnam on $800, backpacking 10 days, street food and culture, April

selected_hotel.name: Sun River Hotel
selected_hotel.location: 134-136 Bach Dang, Hai Chau, Da Nang, VN (16.0675,108.2247)

experiences.name: Da Nang Street Food Night Market
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant street food scene along Bach Dang riverside and Han Market area. Sample local specialties like Banh Mi, Mi Quang (turmeric noodles), Banh Xeo (sizzling crepes), and fresh seafood skewers from bustling night stalls. A quintessential backpacker experience with incredible flavors at rock-bottom prices.
experiences.location: Han Market & Bach Dang Riverside, Hai Chau, Da Nang

experiences.name: Hoi An Ancient Town Cultural Walk
experiences.description: Take a 45-minute bus or motorbike ride south to the UNESCO-listed Hoi An Ancient Town. Wander through lantern-lit streets, visit centuries-old merchant houses, Japanese Covered Bridge, and local temples. Taste Cao Lau noodles and White Rose dumplings unique to this region. A must-do cultural immersion for backpackers.
experiences.location: Hoi An Ancient Town, Quang Nam Province

experiences.name: My Khe Beach Sunrise & Local Breakfast
experiences.description: Walk or cycle to the famous My Khe Beach, just 10 minutes from Bach Dang. Watch the sunrise over the East Sea, then join locals at beachside stalls for Banh Canh (thick noodle soup) and fresh coconut. One of Asia's most beautiful urban beaches, beloved by backpackers for its free access and lively local atmosphere.
experiences.location: My Khe Beach, Son Tra District, Da Nang

experiences.name: Marble Mountains & Local Cave Temples
experiences.description: Hire a motorbike or join a budget group tour to the Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son), a cluster of five limestone hills with ancient Buddhist sanctuaries, hidden caves, and panoramic views of Da Nang. Explore Huyen Khong Cave and Linh Ung Pagoda. A deeply spiritual and culturally rich half-day adventure perfect for backpackers.
experiences.location: Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son), Non Nuoc, Da Nang

experiences.name: Con Market Street Food & Cooking Culture Tour
experiences.description: Dive into Da Nang's oldest and most authentic local market, Con Market, just 1 km from Bach Dang. Join a self-guided or budget group food walk to taste Bun Cha Ca (fish cake noodle soup), fresh spring rolls, and tropical fruits. Chat with vendors, learn about Vietnamese ingredients, and experience everyday local life in a way most tourists miss.
experiences.location: Con Market (Cho Con), Hai Chau District, Da Nang
